{{Youmay|proximity indicators|[[Proximity sensor/Legends|proximity sensors]]}}
'''Proximity indicators''' were standard equipment in [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]] in [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighters]] that warned the pilot of any missiles or other [[Starship/Legends|starships]] that were in the immediate location.
